source.note: Frames come from NASA's visualization (display-stretched), not calibrated radiance.

map_panel.comment: The 32:9 frame holds the same world map twice side by side. Analyse ONE copy: the left one.

geo.comment: Linear (equirectangular) mapping inside the panel. Checked by eye against 12 city locations; expect roughly +/-3 degrees. Re-check on the validation page.

masks_px_in_2048x576_frame.comment: Set to 'no light' (black) before analysis. The year label lies in the RIGHT copy and is outside the left panel, but is masked too for safety.

legend_read_from_change_map.title_text: Change in Lighting Intensity from 2012 to 2023
legend_read_from_change_map.limit: Legend is qualitative (no numeric units), so describe results as direction and relative size, not as radiance values.

layout_check.comment: Mean absolute difference between the two copies is below 1 grey level at a shift of 1024-1025 px.
